answer: Divergent-Challenge Identity Binding: each identity must answer a fresh, unpredictable challenge of its choosing, and its history is anchored to a chained log peers store. Across the atlas of registered identities, any clone copied from the same source shares identical ancestry. A tundra-like sparse sampling of the log forces each claimed identity to exhibit a distinct, unpredictable response branch. If two identities answer alike, both are flagged at the canyon of divergence, since true agents diverge.
